samples.summary: Data-sources list keeps its own hard-coded relative "Created" column, so the new preference/tooltip contract is inconsistent across tables
samples.evidence: packages/frontend/src/app/datasources/datasource-list.tsx:156-163 defines `accessorKey: "createdAt"` and formats it with a bare `formatDistanceToNow(new Date(createdAt), …)` — it does not go through `formatListDate`/`DateCell`, so it ignores the user's Settings choice and carries no `title` tooltip. The Settings copy the change adds (packages/frontend/src/app/settings/page.tsx:65) says the preference governs "the Modified and Created columns … in document lists", which a user will reasonably read as covering this table. It is also the one remaining unguarded `formatDistanceToNow` call in the frontend: an unparseable `createdAt` still throws `RangeError` there, the exact failure mode `parseDate` was introduced to prevent everywhere else. Fix belongs in datasource-list.tsx (route it through `formatListDate`/`formatFullDateTime`), not in the new module.

samples.summary: `NO_DATE` is exported but has no importer anywhere in the repo
samples.evidence: Grep for `NO_DATE` across the whole repo returns only definition and internal uses in packages/frontend/src/app/documents/document-list-utils.ts:81,76,112,127 — no import site, including tests (which assert the literal "—"). knip's unused-exports check runs on packages/frontend (knip.json:17-20) and will flag it; either import it in the tests/callers or drop the `export`.

samples.summary: New localStorage key breaks the repo's existing dotted key convention
samples.evidence: The new key is `"wafflebase-date-format"` (packages/frontend/src/lib/date-format-preference.ts:22) while existing persisted preferences use dots: `wafflebase.board.grid` / `wafflebase.board.grid-snap` (packages/frontend/src/app/board/board-grid.ts:216-262, asserted verbatim in packages/frontend/src/app/board/board-grid.test.ts:197). No functional breakage — nothing enumerates the namespace — just an inconsistent key that future namespace-wide clearing logic would miss.

samples.summary: Other consumers of `formatRelativeTime` are unaffected by the new preference (explicitly scoped out, recorded for completeness)
samples.evidence: packages/frontend/src/components/notifications/notification-item.tsx:47 and packages/frontend/src/app/files/generic-file-view.tsx:41 import `formatRelativeTime` from `@/app/documents/document-list-utils` and keep rendering relative times with no tooltip regardless of the preference; the comments panels use the separate `formatRelativeTime` from `@/lib/utils` (CommentThreadCard.tsx:103, CommentSidePanel.tsx:107, OrphanedCard.tsx:42). docs/tasks/active/20260812-date-display-format-todo.md:58-61 declares this out of scope, so this is informational only — the exported `formatRelativeTime` contract itself is unchanged, so no caller is broken.

finding.summary: The new try/catch around localStorage does not achieve its stated goal: ThemeProvider, which wraps the entire app (including the documents list), still reads localStorage unguarded during render
finding.evidence: packages/frontend/src/components/theme-provider.tsx:41 does `return (localStorage.getItem(storageKey) as Theme) || defaultTheme;` inside a `useState` initializer, with no try/catch. `App.tsx:73` mounts `<ThemeProvider defaultTheme="system" storageKey="vite-ui-theme">` around all routes, so it renders before/above `document-list.tsx:241`'s `useDateFormat()`. In exactly the environments the new comments cite (Safari private mode, blocked third-party storage, sandboxed iframe — note theme-provider.tsx:36 explicitly supports the iframe case), theme-provider throws first and the whole app blanks, so hardening `getDateFormat` alone does not prevent the failure described in packages/frontend/src/lib/date-format-preference.ts:44-48. Fix belongs in theme-provider (or by reusing a shared safe-storage helper such as the ones at packages/frontend/src/app/notes/notes-settings.ts:12-28 and src/components/text-formatting/font-recents.ts:23-26).

verdict.reason: The finding's presence claim is not true of this working tree. It states theme-provider.tsx:41 performs `return (localStorage.getItem(storageKey) as Theme) || defaultTheme;` in a useState initializer with no try/catch. In fact line 41 is blank, and the file contains no unguarded localStorage access: a ripgrep for `localStorage` in packages/frontend/src/components/theme-provider.tsx returns only line 19 (a comment), line 27, and line 35 — lines 27 and 35 sit inside `readStoredTheme` (theme-provider.tsx:25-31, try/catch returning null) and `writeStoredTheme` (theme-provider.tsx:33-40, try/catch swallowing). The render-time read at theme-provider.tsx:61-66 calls the guarded `readStoredTheme(storageKey)`, so a SecurityError in Safari private mode / blocked storage / sandboxed iframe cannot propagate out of render and blank the app. Glob `**/theme-provider*` shows exactly one such file, so there is no second unguarded copy. The mount at App.tsx:73 and the iframe support (theme-provider.tsx:60, `window.self !== window.top`; the finding miscites this as line 36, which is actually the write-path catch) are real but do not establish the defect. The remedy the finding asks for — hardening in theme-provider or a shared safe-storage helper — is already present at theme-provider.tsx:25-40, so the hardening in date-format-preference.ts:42-60 is not defeated as described.
